meta.note: Native macOS app: every color is an AppKit/SwiftUI semantic system color. Values are the macOS 26 defaults for documentation and web mock-ups only; in Swift always use the semantic style, never these hex values.

tokens.name: window-background
tokens.usage: Settings window ground and sidebar (NSColor.windowBackgroundColor). Never set it yourself in SwiftUI; it is what the window already paints.

tokens.name: control-background
tokens.usage: Rows of a grouped Form section (NSColor.controlBackgroundColor), on window-background.

tokens.name: popover-background
tokens.usage: Approximation of the MenuBarExtra window material for mock-ups. In the app the system material paints it; never fill the popover with a color.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text (.primary / labelColor) on window-background, control-background and popover-background.

tokens.name: secondary-label
tokens.usage: Captions, help text and status words (.secondary). System value: in Light it is about 4:1 on control-background, so keep it for captions and hints, never for the only copy of important information.

tokens.name: tertiary-label
tokens.usage: Disabled labels (.tertiary). Decorative weight only: below 3:1, never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: quaternary-fill
tokens.usage: Mouse body fill in MouseIllustration (.quaternary). A surface tint, not a text color.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Divider() lines in the popover and between Form rows (separatorColor).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Color.accentColor: pressed side button fill, selected side button ring, switches, segmented control. Follows the user's system accent; never hard-code it. As text it is about 4:1 on control-background (system value).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on an accent fill (selected segment, prominent button).

tokens.name: status-connected
tokens.usage: 8px status dot when a mouse is connected (Color.green). Always next to the word "Connected": the dot alone is below 3:1 on light grounds.

tokens.name: status-disconnected
tokens.usage: 8px status dot when the mouse is not connected (Color.secondary), next to "Not connected".

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Triangle glyph of ConflictWarning (.orange). Glyph only, never text; the sentence beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error text under a toggle (e.g. launch-at-login failure) and role: .destructive buttons ("Restore default settings").

tokens.name: side-button-idle
tokens.usage: Side button that is neither pressed nor selected in MouseIllustration (.secondary at 35%).

tokens.name: mouse-outline
tokens.usage: 1px outline of the mouse body in MouseIllustration (.secondary at 50%).

tokens.name: mouse-split
tokens.usage: 1px line splitting the left and right click areas in MouseIllustration (.secondary at 40%).

styles.name: title2-bold
styles.usage: .title2.bold(): the app name on the About pane. Once per window at most.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: .headline: the device name heading the menu bar popover.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default style (.body): every Form label, toggle and picker title.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Press a side button on your mouse: it lights up in the picture.
styles.usage: .caption in secondary-label: help lines under a control, status words, the conflict sentence.

styles.name: shortcut
styles.usage: .monospaced(): the ShortcutRecorder button label, so modifier glyphs line up.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the two side buttons and between a control and its caption (VStack spacing 8).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm of the menu bar popover (VStack spacing 10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: About pane stack spacing.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the menu bar popover.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between MouseIllustration and its button picker.

tokens.name: radius-side-button
tokens.usage: Side buttons in MouseIllustration (continuous corners).

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Approximation of a grouped Form section's corners for mock-ups; the system draws them in the app.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsule mouse body and the status dot.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the menu bar popover.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Settings sidebar column (navigationSplitViewColumnWidth).

tokens.name: detail-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a settings pane.

tokens.name: detail-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a settings pane.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of the connection dot.

tokens.name: side-button-width
tokens.usage: Side button width in MouseIllustration.

tokens.name: side-button-height
tokens.usage: Side button height in MouseIllustration.

tokens.name: value-label-width
tokens.usage: Trailing value label after a slider ("250 ms"), monospaced digits, right-aligned. The step multiplier label uses 44px.
